title: Language values of a card
description: A file in data/language/card/, such as data/language/card/li/lightning-bolt/en.json. The name, type line, rules text, and flavor text of one card as one language prints them. The type line keeps its supertypes, card types, and subtypes, and the rules text keeps one entry per ability.

lang.description: The language of these values, such as ja.

name.description: The card name as printed in this language.

flavor_text.description: The flavor text as printed in this language.

history.description: Records of official corrections to these values. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.

type_line.description: The supertypes, card types, and subtypes as this language prints them.

rules_text.description: The rules text as this language prints it, one entry per ability of the card.

ability_id.description: The ability_id of the ability this text belongs to in the card.

text.description: The rules text of that ability as printed in this language.
